routes.action: Install the candidate VSIX in an isolated profile and open main.vela from the workbench.
routes.assertion: Vela language mode, candidate extension and bundled server activate before the deadline; the first query returns the expected result.

routes.action: Open a plain text file from the workbench.
routes.assertion: The file is not associated with Vela.

routes.action: Press the default definition keybinding in dirty Unicode source, then navigate back.
routes.assertion: An unopened target opens at the exact URI/identifier/UTF-16 range; back restores the original file and caret.

routes.action: Select Go to Declaration from the command palette.
routes.assertion: The expected declaration file and identifier range are selected.

routes.action: Select Go to Type Definition from the command palette.
routes.assertion: The type declaration is selected, distinct from the value declaration.

routes.action: Invoke each navigation route on an unresolved identifier.
routes.assertion: No route jumps to an unrelated symbol or enclosing function.

routes.action: Modifier-click a resolvable reference.
routes.assertion: The exact target file and identifier are selected.

routes.action: Open Peek Definition through the context menu and follow the target.
routes.assertion: The widget shows the expected target content and selection, and following it opens the exact file/range.

routes.action: Open Peek Definition and dismiss it.
routes.assertion: Focus returns to the source editor and source text is unchanged.

routes.action: Use modifier-click and Peek Definition on an unknown target.
routes.assertion: No unrelated target or invented peek content appears; source remains unchanged.

routes.action: Type a completion trigger at a mid-token Unicode prefix, move the suggestion selection, inspect resolved details and accept with Enter.
routes.assertion: The expected candidate and documentation appear; exact replacement text and caret match the fixture; undo restores source.

routes.action: Type a completion trigger at a mid-token Unicode prefix, inspect the selected suggestion and accept with Tab.
routes.assertion: The expected candidate and documentation appear; exact replacement text and caret match the fixture; undo restores source.

routes.action: Trigger suggestions and press Escape.
routes.assertion: The suggestion widget closes, focus returns and no completion edit is applied.

routes.action: Press the default rename shortcut, enter a valid name and confirm.
routes.assertion: Exact references change across open/unopened files while shadows stay unchanged; workspace undo/redo restores/reapplies the exact edit.

routes.action: Open Rename, enter a name and cancel.
routes.assertion: The widget closes with no edits to any file.

routes.action: Submit an invalid identifier through Rename.
routes.assertion: The error is visible and no partial workspace edit is applied.

routes.action: Submit a colliding name through Rename.
routes.assertion: The collision is visibly rejected and every document is unchanged.

routes.action: Open references and select each result.
routes.assertion: The panel contains the exact complete reference set and each entry navigates to the expected file/range.

routes.action: Move the caret between read and write occurrences.
routes.assertion: Visible highlights cover the expected ranges with configured read/write styles.

routes.action: Inspect references and highlights for a shadowed identifier.
routes.assertion: Unrelated scopes and their occurrences are excluded.

routes.action: Type a syntax error, open Problems and select its entry.
routes.assertion: The exact code, severity, message and location are visible; selection and decoration cover the expected source span.

routes.action: Repair the source without saving.
routes.assertion: The target problem and decoration disappear while unrelated errors remain.

routes.action: Inspect a valid neighboring location.
routes.assertion: No target-error decoration or incorrect Problems entry is attached to the valid source.

routes.action: Open Quick Fix with the default shortcut, select the expected action and undo.
routes.assertion: Exact source change removes the target diagnostic and preserves unrelated text; undo restores source.

routes.action: Open the lightbulb menu, select the expected action and undo.
routes.assertion: The visible action and exact edit match the fixture; the target diagnostic clears and undo restores source.

routes.action: Open Quick Fix and dismiss the menu.
routes.assertion: No source edit is applied.

routes.action: Invoke Quick Fix where no repair is available.
routes.assertion: No unrelated or unsafe repair appears and the source is unchanged.

routes.action: Edit multiline Unicode token source and scroll out of view and back.
routes.assertion: Expected spans have the configured semantic styles with no stale coloring.

routes.action: Disable semantic highlighting, then enable it again.
routes.assertion: Semantic styles disappear and return on the expected spans without changing source.

routes.action: Edit a resolved reference into an unknown reference.
routes.assertion: The previous resolved semantic style is removed and no unrelated symbol style is guessed.

routes.action: Hover the pointer over the documented target.
routes.assertion: Visible documentation/type matches the fixture and correct source range.

routes.action: Focus the target and invoke hover with the keyboard.
routes.assertion: Visible documentation/type matches the pointer route.

routes.action: Type calls and move between named/defaulted arguments.
routes.assertion: The visible callable and active parameter match each expected argument position.

routes.action: Leave the hover target and separately dismiss the keyboard hover.
routes.assertion: The widget clears and editor focus remains usable.

routes.action: Invoke hover/signature help on an unknown receiver.
routes.assertion: No callable/type facts are invented.

routes.action: Select symbols through Outline.
routes.assertion: Visible names, kinds and parent structure match the fixture and each selection reaches the exact range.

routes.action: Open the document symbol picker and select a symbol.
routes.assertion: The correct name/kind appears and selection reaches the exact range.

routes.action: Open workspace symbols and select an unopened-file target.
routes.assertion: The correct symbol appears and its exact file/range opens.

routes.action: Use a no-match query in each symbol picker.
routes.assertion: No unrelated result is shown.

routes.action: Fold and unfold with gutter controls in Unicode source with a malformed neighbor.
routes.assertion: Exactly the expected lines hide/reappear and text is unchanged.

routes.action: Fold and unfold with keyboard commands.
routes.assertion: Exactly the expected lines hide/reappear and text is unchanged.

routes.action: Expand and shrink selection by keyboard.
routes.assertion: Selections follow the exact fixture nesting and Unicode boundaries.

routes.action: Fold and expand selection beside malformed syntax.
routes.assertion: No unrelated range or invalid Unicode boundary is selected or hidden.

routes.action: Open Call Hierarchy, expand an incoming edge and follow it.
routes.assertion: Visible incoming edges and destinations match exact owners and call-site ranges.

routes.action: Switch Call Hierarchy to outgoing, expand an edge and follow it.
routes.assertion: Visible outgoing edges and destinations match exact owners and call-site ranges.

routes.action: Open Call Hierarchy for an unresolved call.
routes.assertion: No invented edge appears.

routes.action: Format the document through the workbench, repeat formatting and undo.
routes.assertion: Exact text/caret matches the fixture, formatting is idempotent and undo restores source.

routes.action: Format a selected range through the workbench and undo.
routes.assertion: The exact text/caret changes only within the selection, and undo restores source.

routes.action: Type a supported formatting trigger.
routes.assertion: The exact text and caret match the fixture; undo restores the prior source.

routes.action: Disable on-type formatting and type its trigger.
routes.assertion: Only the typed input changes; no formatting edit is applied.

routes.action: Enable hints, edit a call and scroll it into view.
routes.assertion: Exact labels and positions refresh to match the edited parameter identities.

routes.action: Disable inlay hints.
routes.assertion: All hints disappear without source changes.

routes.action: Inspect calls with explicit or unknown facts.
routes.assertion: Hints obey the documented suppression policy and do not invent parameter facts.

routes.action: Edit without saving and switch between importer and definition files.
routes.assertion: Navigation, completion and diagnostics match current buffers and fresh-workspace expectations.

routes.action: Save, close and reopen the edited document.
routes.assertion: Queries match restored disk and the corresponding fresh workspace.

routes.action: Undo and redo edits through the workbench.
routes.assertion: Exact source and query results return to their expected states.

routes.action: Type rapid edits including a syntax error, query the neighbor, then repair.
routes.assertion: No stale generation or guessed result appears; repaired results match the fresh workspace.

routes.action: Create a dependency through Explorer.
routes.assertion: Queries and diagnostics include the new file under the correct workspace owner.

routes.action: Rename a dependency through Explorer.
routes.assertion: Queries reflect the new module path and old locations disappear.

routes.action: Delete a dependency through Explorer.
routes.assertion: The missing dependency is diagnosed and no stale target remains.

routes.action: Change workspace roots and Vela settings through the workbench.
routes.assertion: Queries reflect the current roots/configuration and correct ownership.

routes.action: Replace a static host schema fixture.
routes.assertion: Queries use new metadata and removed schema facts disappear.

routes.action: Introduce missing/invalid configuration and static schema, then repair them.
routes.assertion: Documented diagnostics/degradation appear without stale facts; valid replacement restores permitted results.

routes.action: Stop only the test-owned server, inspect the failure and reload the window.
routes.assertion: Failure is visible and bounded, no duplicate server remains, queries recover and recoverable edits survive.

routes.action: Configure an invalid server path and open a Vela document.
routes.assertion: Startup failure is visible and bounded; no request hangs or automatic restart loop occurs.

Environment expansion is deferred by the local coverage goal.

routes.action: Open an untrusted workspace with trust enabled in the runner.
routes.assertion: Activation and configured-executable behavior match the declared trust policy.

routes.action: Grant trust through the workbench and reload if required.
routes.assertion: Permitted Vela features recover and the intended executable policy is applied.
